content: Applicability of EthGlobalTimeManagedCouplingPort . pdelayRequestPeriod When EthGlobalTimeManagedCouplingPort . pde- layRequestPeriod is not defined or has the value 0 then initiation of propagation delay measurement is disabled for the CouplingPort referenced by couplingPort and the GlobalTimeDomain the EthGlobalTimeManagedCouplingPort belongs to.
